title.zh: 跨国 IPLC 专线维护成本与跑路风险防范：从机房运维到备用容灾体系全方位指南
title.en: International IPLC Circuit Economics & Exit Scam Mitigation: Operational Realities & Failover Strategies

cluster.zh: IPLC 纯专线与全球节点集群

description.zh: 深入探讨跨国企业专线高昂的月度固定带宽租金如何导致不良机场资金链断裂，系统揭示以“三年大促”为代表的跑路特征，并给出个人与出海业务的多订阅容灾备用方案。
description.en: An in-depth analysis of high monthly fixed-line leasing costs, explaining why fragile providers suffer cash-flow collapse and detailing multi-subscription failover architectures against exit scams.
